title: App Tool Categories
description: Apps register toolbar tools per category (selection, filter, create, etc.). Toolbar shows a category control only when that category has registered tools. Migrate all elements App tool registration; remove flat tools list and toolbarItems legacy.
summary: App tools are now `AppTools` (partial record keyed by `AppToolCategory`). `UIToolbar` shows category toggles only for populated categories and renders the active category tools. Removed `toolbarItems` and flat `UIToolbarItem[]` app registration. Migrated geometry play and Storybook; added merge/category tests (45 passing in @elements/ui).
